items.headline: MCA ne AOC-4 & MGT-7 ki deadline badhai
items.what: MCA ne Forms AOC-4 aur MGT-7 file karne ki deadline Circular No. 05/2026 ke through extend kar di hai.
items.who: Sabhi companies jinki annual filing due hai.
items.action: AOC-4 aur MGT-7 forms revised deadline tak file karein.

items.headline: DGFT ne metallic scrap imports ke rules update kiye
items.what: DGFT ne metallic scrap import par PSIC rules revise kiye hain.
items.who: Wo importers jo metallic scrap import karte hain.
items.action: Naye PSIC rule check karein aur import documents accordingly arrange karein.

items.headline: Naye GST rules 2026 phase-wise 1 November se lagu honge
items.what: CBIC ne confirm kiya hai ki naye GST rules 1 November 2026 se phase-wise lagu honge.
items.who: Sare GST registered businesses aur professionals.
items.action: Apne GST compliance process ko naye rules ke hisab se update karen.

items.headline: Manpower supply municipality ko GST exemption nahi milegi
items.what: Uttarakhand AAR ne decide kiya ki segregation na hone par municipal manpower supply ko GST exemption nahi milega, 18% GST lagega.
items.who: Jo agencies municipal manpower supply deti hain bina proper segregation ke.
items.action: Aap manpower bills mein GST charge karen agar segregation nahi hua hai.

items.headline: Photonic switch chassis par ab nil BCD milega
items.what: CAAR Mumbai ne photonic switch chassis assemblies ko 8517 79 90 classification diya aur Notification 57/2017-Customs ke tahat Nil Basic Customs Duty allow kiya.
items.who: Importers jo photonic switch chassis assemblies import karte hain.
items.action: Customs clearance mein correct classification lagayein aur nil BCD ka benefit lein.

items.headline: VAT payment Himachal mein ab online mandatory hai
items.what: Himachal Pradesh ne Rule 37A HP VAT Rules, 2005 me amendment kiya hai, ab sabhi VAT dealers ko payment electronically karna zaroori hai.
items.who: Himachal Pradesh ke saare VAT registered dealers.
items.action: Aapki VAT payment sirf online mode se karein, manual payment accept nahi hogi.

items.headline: MCA ne annual filing ki deadline badhai, late fees bhi maaf
items.what: MCA ne FY26 companies ke annual return filing ki deadlines extend ki aur extra fees maaf kar di hai. Professionals ko filing mein relief milega.
items.who: Sabhi registered companies, CA/CS/CMA professionals jo annual filing karte hain.
items.action: Nayi deadline aur fee waiver details dekhein, time par filing karein.

items.headline: Titanium Dioxide import par anti-dumping duty 5 saal ke liye
items.what: India ne Chinese titanium dioxide par USD 460–681/MT ka anti-dumping duty 5 saal ke liye lagaya hai, Notification No. 26/2026-Customs (ADD) ke tahat.
items.who: Importers jo China se titanium dioxide mangate hain.
items.action: Import duty rate aur Notification ka dhyan rakhein, import costing mein shamil karein.

items.headline: Tamil Nadu mein aviation fuel par VAT kam kiya gaya
items.what: Tamil Nadu sarkar ne flying fuel (Aviation Turbine Fuel) par VAT rate kam kar diya hai. Chennai airport par VAT 29% se 16% aur dusre TN airports par 1% tak laya gaya hai.
items.who: Airline companies, aviation sector aur fuel suppliers Tamil Nadu mein.
items.action: Naye VAT rate ka use karein, billing aur compliance update karein.

items.headline: Goa ne ATF VAT 7% kiya, airlines ko fayda
items.what: Goa sarkar ne aviation turbine fuel (ATF) par VAT rate 7% kar diya hai, 24 October se lagu hai. Airlines ne is move ka swagat kiya hai.
items.who: Airlines, aviation fuel dealers, Goa airports par business karne wale.
items.action: Naye VAT rate ka anuroop invoice aur records update karein.

items.headline: PM-SETU scheme ko Standing Finance Committee ki manzoori mili
items.what: Standing Finance Committee ne PM-SETU scheme approve kiya hai. Scheme startup aur small businesses ke liye focused hai.
items.who: Startups, MSMEs aur entrepreneurs jo government support lete hain.
items.action: Scheme ki guidelines jaari hone ka intezaar karein, eligibility check karen jab notification aaye.

items.headline: 12/2025-Customs (ADD) notification wapas li gayi
items.what: Sarkar ne Notification No. 12/2025-Customs (ADD) ko Notification No. 25/2026-Customs (ADD) se rescind (wapas) kar diya hai. Purane action/omission pe asar nahi hoga.
items.who: Businesses jo us notice ki coverage mein the.
items.action: Nayi notification dekhein, compliance mein latest instruction follow karein.

items.headline: Delhi ke banquet/farmhouses ko event-wise liquor permit lena hoga
items.what: Delhi Excise Dept ne rule banaya hai ki banquet halls aur farmhouses ko har event ke liye alag se liquor permit lena padega.
items.who: Banquet halls, farmhouses, event managers jo Delhi mein shadi ya party rakhte hain.
items.action: Har event se pehle permit apply karein, compliance ko check karen.

items.headline: Goa ne draft shops & establishments rules jaari kiye, feedback mangi
items.what: Goa government ne naye shops and establishments rules ka draft jaari kiya hai. 15 din ke andar feedback maanga hai.
items.who: Shops, business owners aur HR/compliance professionals Goa mein.
items.action: Draft rules padhein aur feedback 15 din ke andar bhejein.

items.headline: AOC-4 and MGT-7 filing date badhi FY26 ke liye
items.what: MCA ne FY 2025-26 ke liye AOC-4 filing ki last date 31 December 2026 aur MGT-7/MGT-7A ki last date 31 January 2027 kar di hai. Extra fees nahi lagengi.
items.who: Sabhi companies jo FY 2025-26 ki ROC filings karti hain.
items.action: AOC-4 ko 31 December 2026 tak aur MGT-7/MGT-7A ko 31 January 2027 tak bina late fees ke file karein.

items.headline: Chinese Titanium Dioxide par anti-dumping duty lagi
items.what: India ne Chinese origin Titanium Dioxide par USD 460–681 per MT anti-dumping duty lagayi hai. Duty paanch saal tak rahegi.
items.who: Titanium Dioxide import karne wale traders aur manufacturers.
items.action: Import order karte waqt duty cost ka hisaab laga lein aur applicable duty pay karein.

items.headline: Notification 12/2025-Customs (ADD) ab khatam
items.what: Sarkar ne Notification 12/2025-Customs (ADD) ko ab rescind kar diya hai. Jo kaam pehle ho chuke hain unpe farq nahi padega.
items.who: Jo log Customs (ADD) notification ka compliance kar rahe hain.
items.action: Ab se Notification 12/2025-Customs (ADD) ka istemal na karein. Naye rules dekhein.

items.headline: Chemical products ke liye naye SION norms notify hue
items.what: DGFT ne chemical aur allied products ke liye 4 naye Standard Input-Output Norms (SION) notify kiye hain. Isse advance authorisations process tez hoga.
items.who: Exporters jo chemical & allied products export karte hain.
items.action: Exporters apne advance authorisation applications mein naye SION norms ka reference dein.

items.headline: TN airports par ATF VAT rate ab sirf 1%
items.what: Tamizh Nadu mein Chennai airport par ATF VAT rate 16% aur dusre TN airports par sirf 1% kar diya gaya hai.
items.who: ATF (aviation turbine fuel) kharidne wale airlines ya fuel suppliers Tamil Nadu ke airports par.
items.action: 1 November 2026 se nayi VAT rates applicable hain; fuel procurement ki costing accordingly karein.

items.headline: Goa mein ATF VAT rate ab 7% hua
items.what: Goa sarkar ne aviation turbine fuel par VAT rate 7% kar diya hai jo 24 October 2026 se lagu hua.
items.who: Airlines aur jet fuel sellers jo Goa se fuel proc ure karte hain.
items.action: Fuel billing mein naya VAT rate adjust karein for Goa airport supplies.

items.headline: Duty-Free Raw Sugar Import ki last date ab 31 Dec 2026
items.what: Sarkar ne 10 lakh MT Tariff Rate Quota scheme mein raw sugar ka duty-free import karne ki deadline 31 December 2026 tak badha di hai.
items.who: Raw sugar importers jo is scheme ka use karte hain.
items.action: Duty-free raw sugar import scheme ka benefit 31 December 2026 tak le sakte hain.

items.headline: Goa: draft shops & establishments rules pe feedback invite hua
items.what: Goa sarkar ne draft shops and establishments rules notify kiye hain. 15 din ke andar feedback manga gaya hai.
items.who: Shop owners aur businesses Goa mein.
items.action: Rules ko padhein aur 15 din ke andar feedback submit karein agar koi sujhav ya objection ho.

items.headline: Raw Sugar Customs Duty Exemption Extended
items.what: CBIC ne Notification No. 30/2026-Customs ki validity 31 October se badha kar 31 December 2026 kar di hai. Raw sugar par customs duty exemption ab lamba chalega.
items.who: Sugar importers aur traders jo raw sugar import karte hain.
items.action: Raw sugar import karte waqt exemption ka fayda uthayein. Do import planning accordingly.

items.headline: Goa: ATF VAT 7% ho gaya 24 Oct se
items.what: Goa sarkar ne aviation turbine fuel (ATF) par VAT ab 7% kar diya hai, 24 October se lagu.
items.who: Aviation companies, airline operators jo Goa mein ATF kharidte hain.
items.action: Fuel billing aur pricing mein naya VAT rate use karein.

items.headline: Delhi banquet/farmhouse events: liquor permit ab event-wise
items.what: Banquet halls aur farmhouses ko har event ke liye alag liquor permit lena hoga. Ye Excise department ka naya niyam hai.
items.who: Delhi ke banquet halls, farmhouses, event organizers.
items.action: Event se pehle har baar naya liquor permit apply karein.

items.headline: Kerala: Labour Code ke liye committee bani
items.what: Kerala sarkar ne naya Labour Code evaluate karne ke liye committee banayi hai. Is committee ka kaam code ki study aur implementation plan banana hai.
items.who: State mein kaam kar rahe business aur employers, workers aur trade unions.
items.action: Labour law compliance update ke liye committee ki recommendations ka intezaar karein.

items.headline: Delhi Skill Scheme 2026: Rs 400 daily stipend
items.what: Delhi Govt ne Skill Scheme 2026 notify ki hai jisme training lene walon ko Rs 400 per day stipend milega.
items.who: Youngsters jo Delhi Govt ke skill development/training programme join karte hain.
items.action: Skill scheme ke liye apply karein aur training period mein stipend ka fayda uthayein.

items.headline: Delhi EV Policy 2026 notified: road tax exemption
items.what: Delhi sarkar ne Electric Vehicle Policy 2026 notify kar di hai. Policy mein road tax exemption aur phased EV-only registrations ka vada hai.
items.who: EV buyers aur automobile dealers in Delhi.
items.action: Nayi policy ke rules padhein. Road tax exemption ka benefit nikal sakte hain, EV registrations mein naya phase aa sakta hai.

items.headline: Rajasthan: Industrial Development Policy 2026 aayi
items.what: Rajasthan sarkar ne Industrial Development Policy 2026 launch ki hai. Policy mein semiconductors, GCCs, aur USD 350 billion target economy par focus hai.
items.who: Investors, business owners aur manufacturers jo Rajasthan mein kaam karte/karna chahte hain.
items.action: Industrial policy ki details dekhein, naye incentives aur sector-specific opportunities samjhein.

items.headline: Kullu Pomegranates export hua Dubai
items.what: 1.3 MT Kullu ke Anar Dubai export kiye gaye hain. Indian horticulture exports mein yeh ek bada kadam hai.
items.who: Fruit exporters aur Kullu pomegranate growers par lagu.
items.action: Export ki maujooda policies follow karein. Exporters apna documentation ready rakhein.

items.headline: GST margin scheme auction intermediary ko nahi milega
items.what: Maharashtra AAR ne decide kiya hai ki GST margin scheme sirf second-hand goods dealers ke liye hai, pure auction intermediary ke liye nahi. Alag valuation method lagega.
items.who: Auction intermediary aur second-hand goods business wale traders par lagu.
items.action: Agar aap auction intermediary hain toh margin scheme ka labh nahi milega. Apne GST valuation method ko accordingly adjust karein.

items.headline: IPO fresh issue par GST ITC milega, OFS par nahi
items.what: Telangana AAR ne clarify kiya hai ki IPO ke fresh issue ke business expenses par GST ITC allowed hai, par Offer for Sale (OFS) ke expenses par nahi.
items.who: IPO launch karne wale companies aur unke tax consultants par lagu.
items.action: Agar IPO ka fresh issue hai toh related GST ITC claim kar sakte hain. OFS ke expenses par nahi kar sakte.

items.headline: Reverse charge ke liye e-invoicing mein do naye category
items.what: GSTN ne e-invoicing portal par reverse charge purchases ke liye do naye category add kiye hain. Yeh compliance aur reporting mein madad degi.
items.who: Reverse charge mechanism se supply lene wale GST taxpayers par lagu.
items.action: Reverse charge ki purchases e-invoicing mein naye categories ke hisaab se file karein. E-invoice portal pe check kar lein.

items.headline: Small e-commerce sellers ka GST registration 1 Nov se shuru
items.what: Small e-commerce sellers ke liye GST registration process 1 November se shuru ho raha hai. Yeh compliance ko streamline karega.
items.who: Jo chhote sellers e-commerce platforms pe bechte hain, unpar lagu.
items.action: 1 November se GST registration process start kar dein agar abhi tak nahi kiya toh.

items.headline: Private companies: AGM 24-hour notice possible?
items.what: Section 136 ke tahat private companies general meeting ke liye 24 ghante ka notice de sakti hain, par kuch sharten aur hurdles apply hongi. 2017 amendments ke bi kuch naye conditions hain.
items.who: Private companies ke promoters, secretaries aur ROC consultants par lagu.
items.action: Articles of Association check karein aur AGM/EGM notice period ki compliance sahi se dekhein.

items.headline: Telecom regulatory sandbox rules 2026 notify hue
items.what: Centre ne telecom sector ke liye sandbox rules 2026 notify kiye hain. Nayi technology ko test karne ka legal system ab available hai.
items.who: Telecom companies, startups aur new technology developers par lagu.
items.action: Agar nayi telecom tech test karni hai to sandbox rules 2026 ki application process dekhein.

items.headline: Health & Life Insurance par GST ITC rules mein change aane wale hain
items.what: 57th GST Council meeting mein group health aur life insurance par input tax credit (ITC) rules relax karne ka proposal discuss hua hai. Section 17(5) ke changes, employee coverage, premium recovery aur ISD rules par focus hai.
items.who: Jin businesses ne group health ya life insurance apne employees ko diya hai.
items.action: Agar aap apne employees ke liye insurance ka premium dete hain, toh naye ITC eligibility rules aane par apni compliance policies update karein.

items.headline: Government bonds par tax exemption ke liye naya Form 173A
items.what: CBDT ne Rule 281A aur Form 173A notify kiya hai jisse government securities par milne wale interest aur capital gains par income tax exemption claim ki ja sakegi.
items.who: Jin tax payers ke paas government securities hai ya aise invest karna chahte hain.
items.action: Agar aapko government bonds par interest ya capital gains exemption chahiye toh naya Form 173A use kar sakte hain.

items.headline: Reverse charge ke self-invoices ab E-Invoice system mein bana sakte hain
items.what: GSTN ne reverse charge (RCM) supplies ke liye self-invoice (RCMDOM, RCMIMP) generate karne ki capability E-Invoice system mein add ki hai. Ab IRN generate possible hai, lekin abhi mandatory nahi hai.
items.who: Jin businesses ka aggregate turnover ₹5 crore ya usse zyada hai aur reverse charge cases mein self-invoice banaate hain.
items.action: Agar aap reverse charge ke liye self-invoice banaate hain, toh E-Invoice system ka optional use kar sakte hain. Regulatory updates ka wait karein for any compulsion.

items.headline: GSTR-3B ke liye due dates extend, late fee maaf
items.what: CBIC ne GST GSTR-3B return filing ki due dates badhai hain aur kuch taxpayers ke liye late fee bhi maaf ki hai.
items.who: Jo businesses GSTR-3B return file karte hain.
items.action: Apne portal par relevant month ki extended due date check karein aur late fee waiver ka benefit lein.

items.headline: India–New Zealand FTA: 20 Oct se Indian exports par zero tariff
items.what: DGFT ne bataya ki India-New Zealand FTA ke tahat 20 October se sabhi Indian exports par New Zealand mein duty khatam ho jayegi.
items.who: Exporters jo New Zealand ko goods bhejte hain.
items.action: New Zealand ko export karne wale businesses FTA ka benefit lene ke liye export documentation mein proper mention karein.

items.headline: October 2026 GST return se pehle 12 critical checks karein
items.what: FY 2025-26 GST compliance aur ITC, credit notes, RCM, ISD, IMS aur key deadlines ki review list GSTN ne release ki hai. October 2026 ke return file karne se pehle inn points par focus karein.
items.who: Har registered GST taxpayer, especially jo October 2026 ke returns file karenge.
items.action: October 2026 return se pehle 12 points ki review checklist follow karein, jaise credit notes/RCM/ISD compliance.

items.headline: Form CRA-4: Cost audit report file karne ka 30 din ka niyam
items.what: FY 2025-26 ke liye MCA ne guide jaari ki hai jisme Form CRA-4 file karne ka process, XBRL filing, Board review aur attachments ka compliance explain hua hai. Receipt milne ke 30 din ke andar file karna hoga.
items.who: Companies jin par cost audit applicable hai.
items.action: Cost audit report milte hi 30 days ke andar Form CRA-4 file karein, XBRL aur supporting documents attach karein.

items.headline: 57th GST Council Meeting—registration aur Section 175 reforms
items.what: 57th GST Council meeting mein registration process, IMS reconciliation aur Section 175 mein statutory reforms discuss hue hain.
items.who: GST registered businesses aur professionals.
items.action: Detailed reforms ka wait karein, official notification ke aane par rules samjhein.

items.headline: Delhi: Fire audit transition period ab May 2027 tak
items.what: Delhi sarkar ne fire safety audit ke transition period ko extend kiya hai. Ab implementation May 2027 se hoga.
items.who: Delhi ke business premises jise fire audit karana hai.
items.action: May 2027 tak transition planning karein aur compliance ensure karein.

items.headline: CBDT: Nai disclosure govt securities ke tax-free gain par
items.what: CBDT ne naye disclosure mandate kiye hain jab aap govt securities par tax-free gains claim karte hain.
items.who: Wo log ya firms jinhe govt securities par tax-free income milti hai.
items.action: Return file karte waqt nai disclosure requirements ka palan karein.

items.headline: CBDT: Form 173A launched for tax exemption claims
items.what: CBDT ne Form 173A introduce kiya hai, jo government securities par tax exemption claim karne ke liye istemal hoga.
items.who: Jo log ya company govt securities par tax exemption claim karte hain.
items.action: Exemption claim karte waqt Form 173A ka upyog karein.

items.headline: India-NZ FTA: Naye Rules of Origin October 20, 2026 se
items.what: CBIC ne India–New Zealand Free Trade Agreement ke liye naye Rules of Origin notify kare hain. Effective October 20, 2026 se lagu honge.
items.who: Import-export companies jo NZ ke saath trade karti hain.
items.action: FTA benefit lene ke liye new origin rules ko samjhein; October 20, 2026 ke baad unka palan karein.

items.headline: Delhi: ₹50 cr Go-Delhi Foundation startup scheme approved
items.what: Delhi sarkar ne ₹50 crore Go-Delhi Foundation approve ki hai, jo startups ko prototype se market tak laane mein madad karegi.
items.who: Delhi-based startups aur entrepreneurs.
items.action: Foundation ke process aur opportunities ko follow karein. Helpful for early-stage startups.

items.headline: Delhi approves new Industrial Policy 2026, focus on 10 sectors
items.what: Dilli sarkar ne 2026 tak ke liye nayi industrial policy approve ki hai, jo 10 priority sectors ko incentive degi.
items.who: Delhi ke manufacturing aur service sector ke businesses.
items.action: Agar incentive plan lena ho toh nayi policy ke clauses padhkar apply karein.

items.headline: UP Textile & Garmenting Policy: Incentives detail
items.what: Uttar Pradesh Ne Textile and Garmenting Policy 2022 launch ki hai. Policy me incentives, eligibility aur implementation ke bare me bataya gaya hai.
items.who: Policy sabhi textile aur garmenting industry stakeholders par lagu hai jo eligibility criteria meet karte hain.
items.action: Industry players eligibility check karke incentives ka labh utha sakte hain.

items.headline: Maharajah Bonds: TDS exemption mil gaya
items.what: Maharajah Bonds par TDS exemption de diya gaya hai. Isse investors ka interest badh raha hai.
items.who: Maharajah Bonds purchase karne wale investors par lagu hai.
items.action: Investors ko bond returns par TDS nahi katega; tax compliance dekh lein.

items.headline: Tamil Nadu ne GST goods movement checks easy kiya
items.what: Tamil Nadu ne naye GST checks adopt kiye hain jisse goods ka movement asaan ho jayega. Checks ka process simplify kiya gaya hai.
items.who: State me GST registered traders aur transporters par lagu.
items.action: Traders aur transporters naye checks ke hisaab se goods movement plan karein.

items.headline: GST E-Way Bill: 4 naye rules laye gaye
items.what: GST E-Way Bill process me 4 major changes aaye hain. Nai compliance rules lagu hue hain.
items.who: Har GST taxpayer jise E-Way Bill banana padta hai un par lagu.
items.action: Taxpayers ko latest E-Way Bill rules padh kar apni compliance update karni hogi.

items.headline: Delhi: ₹50 crore Go-Delhi Foundation startup fund
items.what: Delhi sarkar ne ₹50 crore ka Go-Delhi Foundation approve kiya hai startups aur innovation ko boost karne ke liye.
items.who: Naye aur existing startups jo Delhi me register hain, fund ka fayda utha sakte hain.
items.action: Startups scheme me apply karke venture funding, support aur incentives le sakte hain.

items.headline: Punjab: New industrial development scheme approved
items.what: Punjab ne naye industrial development aur export promotion scheme ko approval diya hai. Scheme updates bataye gaye hain.
items.who: Industrial aur export sector ke businesses par lagu.
items.action: Business owners naye scheme ka detail dekhein aur apply karein agar eligible hain.

items.headline: India–NZ Free Trade New Rules: 20 Oct se lagu
items.what: CBIC ne India–New Zealand Free Trade Agreement ke Rules of Origin notify kiye. Naye rules 20 Oct 2026 se effect me hain.
items.who: Import-export businesses dealing with New Zealand goods par lagu.
items.action: Traders ko apni sourcing aur compliance ko naye Rules of Origin ke hisaab se check karna hoga.

items.headline: Tariff quota: New Zealand fruits & honey import par
items.what: New Zealand se fruits aur honey ke import par tariff quota notify kiya gaya hai. Is quota se import volume regulate hoga.
items.who: Importers jo New Zealand se fruits aur honey mangwate hain.
items.action: Importers quota limit aur custom notification check karein trade planning ke liye.

items.headline: NDB ke rupee bonds: Interest payment par TDS nahi
items.what: CBDT ne New Development Bank ke rupee-denominated bonds par interest payments ko TDS se exempt kiya hai.
items.who: Jisne New Development Bank ke rupee bonds me invest kiya hai, unpar lagu.
items.action: Investors ko ab is interest income par TDS nahi katega, documentation maintain karein.

items.headline: Delhi approves Industrial Policy 2026 for 10 sectors
items.what: Delhi Cabinet ne Industrial Policy 2026 pass ki hai jisme 10 priority sectors ko incentive milega. Policy focus growth aur innovation par hai.
items.who: Delhi ke industrial aur manufacturing businesses jin sectors ko scheme me include kiya gaya hai.
items.action: Eligible units incentive aur policy detail check karke benefit lein.

items.headline: Delhi ne Industrial Policy 2026 approve ki
items.what: Delhi sarkar ne Industrial Policy 2026 ko manzoori di hai. Isme 10 priority sectors ke liye incentives hain.
items.who: Delhi ke businesses, investors aur industrial units.
items.action: Naye incentives ka use karne ke liye policy details dekhein. Relevant sector ke hisab se apply karein.

items.headline: Delhi mein startups ke liye ₹50 crore Go-Delhi Foundation
items.what: Delhi Cabinet ne Go-Delhi Foundation ko approve kiya hai jisme ₹50 crore ka fund hai startups aur innovation ko badhava dene ke liye.
items.who: Delhi ke naye startups aur innovative ventures mein kaam karne wale log.
items.action: Startups policy ki details dekhen, funding ke liye apply karein jab window open ho.

items.headline: Tamil Nadu: Roving Squads abolished, goods vehicle checking strict hua
items.what: Tamil Nadu GST department ne roving squads khatam kiye hain. Ab goods vehicles sirf specific intelligence aur Joint Commissioner ke prior authorisation se check honge.
items.who: Tamil Nadu me goods bechne, kharidne ya bhejne wale businesses aur transporters.
items.action: GST compliance ke time pe updated checking rules ka dhyan rakhein. Random checking ab nahi hogi.

items.headline: Annual GST Return aur Quarterly Payment B2C businesses ke liye propose hua
items.what: GST Council ne proposal diya hai ki B2C businesses jinka turnover ₹5 crore tak hai, wo ek annual GST return file karein aur tax quarterly pay karein.
items.who: Unregistered B2C businesses jinka turnover annual ₹5 crore tak hai.
items.action: Jab scheme lagu ho jaye to annual GST return aur quarterly payment ka option choose karein.

items.headline: DGFT ne New Tariff Rate Quotas notify kiye New Zealand FTA me
items.what: DGFT ne apples, kiwifruit, albumins aur Manuka Honey import par naye Tariff Rate Quotas notify kiye hain, jo India–New Zealand FTA ke tehat aayenge.
items.who: In products ka import/export karne wale traders aur businesses.
items.action: Quota ki terms aur FTA ki conditions check karein. Imports plan karte waqt latest quota limit dekhein.

items.headline: CBIC ne Customs Duty Concessions notify ki New Zealand imports par
items.what: CBIC notification 32/2026-Customs se kuch New Zealand se import hone wali items par duty aur cess mein chhoot di gayi hai, origin aur quota conditions ke saath.
items.who: New Zealand se maal import karne wale Indian importers.
items.action: Import aur duty payment se pehle notification ki detail check karein. Origin, quota aur rules ki compliance karein.

items.headline: Income Tax Form 141 Schedule E: NRI property par naye rules 1 Oct 2026 se
items.what: Income Tax Department ne Form 141 me Schedule E jod diya hai, jo NRI se property kharidne par TDS, filing aur correction rules samjhata hai. Effective 1 October 2026.
items.who: Resident individual/HUF jo non-resident se property kharid rahe hain.
items.action: Property deal se pehle naye Form 141 Schedule E rules padhkar TDS filing ki tayari karein.

items.headline: GST ITC ka cutoff FY 2025-26 ke liye 30 Nov 2026
items.what: GST input tax credit (ITC) lene ka cutoff FY 2025-26 ke invoices ke liye 30 November 2026 ya annual return fil hone tak hai. GSTR-2B, IMS aur vendor correction ka role.
items.who: Har GST registered business jisko FY 2025-26 ka ITC lena hai.
items.action: Invoice reconciliation, GSTR-2B aur corrections November ke end tak complete karein.

items.headline: Udyam Assist Platform formalises micro enterprises
items.what: Udyam Assist Platform (2023) ka aim hai informal micro enterprises ko formal sector mein lana. Isse businesses ko sarkari schemes ka faayda mil sakta hai.
items.who: India ke informal micro enterprises ke liye.
items.action: Agar aapka business abhi informal hai to Udyam Assist Platform par registration karein, formalisation ka faayda uthayein.

items.headline: Tamil Nadu ends roving squads for GST checks

items.who: Tamil Nadu mein goods transport karne wale businesses par lagu.

items.action: Object change se pehle compliance check karo. Naye registration apply karo agar object tax laws se nahi milte.

items.headline: Sunday ko bhi khule rahenge Punjab excise office property tax ke liye

items.headline: AP mein GST AAR reconstitute, naye members appointed

items.headline: Chandigarh: Natural Gas VAT 12.5% se 5% hua

items.headline: Fresh Psyllium Seeds par 5% GST lagu: Rajasthan AAR

items.headline: Godown rent (agri warehousing) par 18% GST lagega: Gujarat AAR
items.what: AAR Gujarat ne decide kiya ki agricultural warehousing ke godown rent par 18% GST lagega. Unregistered godown se hire karne par RCM 10.10.2024 se apply hoga.

items.action: Godown rent par 18% GST charge karein ya pay karein. Agar unregistered se godown liya hai to 10.10.2024 se RCM follow karein.

items.headline: Delhi govt ko 5,500+ EV incentive applications mile
items.what: Nayi electric vehicle (EV) policy ke tahat, Delhi govt ko 5,500 se jyada applications incentive ke liye mile hain.

items.action: Agar application daali hai to processing ka wait karein. Nayi applications EV policy ke tahat dalein.

items.action: Sab equipment ke bundle pe highest GST rate lagakar GST pay karein.

items.headline: Haryana business law: 15-day clearance rule for MSMEs

items.headline: Import/Export of 47 Chemicals: IUPAC & CAS Number Mandatory

items.action: Declarations mein IUPAC name aur CAS number add karne ki taiyari karein.

items.what: CBIC ne Draft Warehousing Operations Regulations, 2026 issue kiya hai aur stakeholders se 15 din mein comments maange hain. Yeh regulations public aur private warehouses par lagu honge.

items.action: Draft regulations padhein aur feedback 15 din ke andar bhejein.

items.headline: Property Sale: NRI Se Property Kharidne Par TDS Rules Easy From 1 Oct

items.headline: DURGA Scheme: 1,300 Pink E-Autos for Women/Transgender

items.what: Haryana Sarkar ne naya business law pass kiya hai jisse MSMEs ko clearance sirf 15 din mein mil jayegi, ab der nahi hogi.

items.headline: Fresh Psyllium Seeds Par 5% GST, Exemption Nahi: Rajasthan AAR
items.what: Rajasthan AAR ne bola fresh Psyllium seeds par 5% GST lagega (HSN 12119013), exemption nahi milegi.

items.headline: Mutual Credit Guarantee Scheme for MSMEs revised

items.headline: Chandigarh ne natural gas VAT 12.5% se 5% kiya
items.what: Chandigarh administration ne natural gas par VAT rate 12.5% se ghata kar 5% kar diya hai.

items.action: Apne billing aur cost calculation ko naye VAT rate ke hisaab se update karein.

items.headline: Professional coaching (ACCA/CMA/CPA) par GST exemption nahi

items.action: Coaching providers aur students ab GST ka dhyaan rakhein, invoices mein GST include karein.

items.what: Kerala AAR ne Nata De Coco ko HSN 21069099 mein classify kiya hai. Is par 21.09.2025 tak 18% aur 22.09.2025 se 5% GST lagega.

items.headline: Chandigarh DLSA advocates empanelment scheme approved
items.what: Justice Anoop Chitkara ne Chandigarh District Legal Services Authority ke liye advocates ke empanelment ki scheme approve ki hai.

items.action: Interested advocates DLSA ki panel empanelment scheme ki guidelines follow karke apply karein.
